tasks.title: Finalize umbrella proposal and lane boundaries
tasks.summary: Turn the umbrella feat into an execution-grade lane plan with explicit boundaries between mount refresh, external seam, and proof-layer follow-up work.
notes: Execution order is T-002 -> T-003 -> T-004.
T-002 goes first because mount refresh scope/budget/refusal semantics are the clearest leftover contract gap from f-223crkgwk and should not be retrofitted after new control surfaces appear.
T-003 follows T-002 so external seam phase 2 can evolve without stealing mount-control semantics or widening shell scope casually.
T-004 remains downstream proof work and must validate or harden checked-in evidence without driving upstream runtime semantics.
